core_obligations: Reduce to the case of a surjective map from an irreducible space by replacing the subset by its preimage situation and the target by the image (proof lines 1092-1093)
Nonemptiness: the target is nonempty because the source is (proof lines 1094-1095)

Irreducibility: given a cover of the target by two closed subsets, their preimages are closed and cover the irreducible source, so one of them is everything, and surjectivity transfers this back (proof lines 1095-1099)
proof_roadmap: 不妨设 E = X（X 不可约）、f 满射、f(E) = Y。
若 Y = Y_1 ∪ Y_2（Y_i 闭），则 X = f^{-1}(Y_1) ∪ f^{-1}(Y_2)（闭）；由 X 不可约取其一等于 X ⇒ 由满射得对应的 Y_i = Y。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the image of an irreducible subset under a continuous map is irreducible (author lemma at source lines 1085-1090, label lemma-image-irreducible-space). The proof (source lines 1092-1100) reduces to the case of a surjective map from an irreducible space and argues by pulling back a hypothetical decomposition by two closed subsets (proof lines 1092-1099). The reduction and the pullback argument are the content. H2.
